classification.difficultyReason: Apply exact trigonometric ratios successively in two triangles sharing a side.

content.prompt: Find $x$ in each of the following figures:

spec.description: Two outlined right triangles share a base; their hypotenuses cross. Both right-angle marks and vertex angles are retained.
spec.mathematics: Right vertical side 6; left vertical side x; upper-right angle 30 degrees; upper-left angle 45 degrees.

spec.description: Nested right triangles share a base and bottom-right right angle. The right vertical side is explicitly divided into lower segment 3 and upper segment x.
spec.mathematics: Upper vertex angle 30 degrees; intermediate vertex angle 45 degrees; total vertical length x+3.

spec.description: Upper and lower triangles share the perpendicular horizontal segment; their left vertices are collinear.
spec.mathematics: Upper hypotenuse sqrt(8), upper-left angle 45 degrees, lower-left angle 30 degrees, lower hypotenuse x.

answer.worked:
Let $b$ be the shared horizontal side.
$$\begin{align*}\sin45^\circ&=\frac{b}{\sqrt8}\\b&=\sqrt8\times\frac1{\sqrt2}\\b&=2\\\sin30^\circ&=\frac2x\\x&=4.\end{align*}$$

spec.description: A right triangle contains a segment from an intermediate point on its left side to the bottom-right vertex.
spec.mathematics: Internal hypotenuse 6, angle between that segment and downward vertical 60 degrees; outer upper-left angle 45 degrees; outer hypotenuse x.
